label: Milk chocolate
note: Condensed milk was how Daniel Peter (Switzerland, 1875) first got milk into chocolate; Nestlé’s neighbour Henri Nestlé had just made it. British milk chocolate still uses crumb, and its Maillard browning gives a cooked caramel flavour. Germany, France and Belgium mostly add milk powder.

about.text: Solid chocolate made of cocoa products, sugar and milk or milk products. In the EU it must hold at least 25 % cocoa solids and 14 % dry milk solids.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: At least 25 % cocoa solids (2.5 % dry non-fat) and 14 % dry milk solids, 3.5 % of it milk fat
